detect_sleep.note: Phase 3 LF/HF-degraded (D-01). Observed drifts on 5 fixture nights (2026-06-10..14): efficiency 1.7%-18.5% relative, TST 12.7%-112% relative. Large TST drifts come from in-bed boundary misdetection caused by the LF/HF-degraded classifier (parasympHigh=rmssdHigh only, hf/lf/lfhf=NaN). Phase 5 tightens when hrv_from_rr fills frequency-domain fields.

detect_sleep_tst.note: Phase 3 LF/HF-degraded TST budget. Max observed drift ~112% on 2026-06-10 (Swift TST=665 min vs oracle 313 min, due to in-bed detection boundary error from missing LF/HF features).

detect_sleep_efficiency.note: Phase 3 LF/HF-degraded efficiency budget. Max observed drift ~18.5% on 2026-06-10.

detect_sleep_epoch_labels.note: LOCAL DIVERGENCE (intentional): Stage 3c min bout-duration smoothing (enforceMinBout) is applied on-device but has no equivalent in the Python oracle, so Swift labels intentionally diverge further from the oracle hypnogram. Accepted under the local-first principle — the on-device engine is the source of truth. Budget raised from 0.40 to 0.60 to cover the added deep/rem/light run absorption; the test prints the actual per-night flip fraction. Underlying Phase 3 LF/HF-degraded drift (D-01, parasympHigh=rmssdHigh only) still applies; observed pre-min-bout flips were 19.9%-34.4% across the 5 fixture nights. Daily TST/efficiency are largely preserved because min-bout redistributes stages rather than total sleep time.

clean_rr.note: Phase 4 kubios fixpeaks: atol=0.5ms on nnClean (D-07). Structural counts (nBeats, nArtifacts, peaksClean.count) asserted exact separately.

welch_psd.note: Phase 5 Welch PSD bins: atol on normalized power vs scipy.welch. nperseg rounded to next power-of-2 for vDSP compatibility.

hrv_frequency_lf.note: Phase 5 HRV frequency LF band: Spearman rho >= 0.90 on per-epoch values across a full night session.

hrv_frequency_hf.note: Phase 5 HRV frequency HF band: Spearman rho >= 0.90 on per-epoch values across a full night session.

hrv_frequency_lfhf.note: Phase 5 HRV LF/HF ratio: Spearman rho >= 0.90 on per-epoch values across a full night session.

update_baseline.note: Phase 6 Baselines: pure EWMA Double — deterministic, no approximation

fold_history.note: Phase 6 Baselines: sequential fold via updateBaseline — deterministic

recovery_score.note: Phase 6 Recovery: closed-form logistic squash — no iteration

strain.note: Phase 6 Strain: log-map + TRIMP — floating-point accumulation over ~86400 samples

strain_with_evidence.note: Phase 6 Strain: same budget as strain

stress_timeline.note: Phase 6 Stress: 60s bucket rounding + Python round(..., 2)

estimate_bout_calories.note: Phase 6 Calories: linear formulas, accumulation over samples

daily.note: Phase 6 DailyEngine: aggregation of module fields — tolerance = max of dependencies

compute_advice.note: Phase 7 AdviceEngine: advice codes are exact-match (String); numeric params (debt_min, target_strain) use atol=1.0 (values in minutes or score 0-21)
